nodes.procedure: NF was cleaned using the same procedures as FF: stirring treatment in 0.1 M HCl solution for 10 min and severally rinsing with deionized water and ethanol for three times.
nodes.source_text: Ni₂P-NF was fabricated using the same procedures as Ni₂P/FeP-FF except for the FF was replaced by NF.

nodes.name: Ni deposition on Ni foam
nodes.procedure: The cleaned NF was immersed in a beaker with NaCl and NiCl₂ solution (0.5 M NaCl + 0.5 M NiCl₂) and stirred for 12 h at room temperature. After drying,
nodes.source_text: Ni₂P-NF was fabricated using the same procedures as Ni₂P/FeP-FF except for the FF was replaced by NF.

nodes.name: Phosphating Ni2P-NF
nodes.procedure: the modified NF and NaH₂PO₂ (2 g) was placed at the downstream and upstream side of the tube furnace, respectively. The Ni₂P-NF was obtained after heating to 300°C (2°C min⁻¹) for 1 h with N₂ gas flowing at 50 sccm.
nodes.source_text: Ni₂P-NF was fabricated using the same procedures as Ni₂P/FeP-FF except for the FF was replaced by NF.

nodes.name: Gas phase phosphating of cleaned Fe foam (FeP-FF)
nodes.procedure: FeP-FF was synthesized using the same phosphating procedure as Ni₂P/FeP-FF but with no nickel source added. The cleaned FF and NaH₂PO₂ (2 g) was placed at the downstream and upstream side of the tube furnace, respectively (Note: the upstream was closed to the air inlet). FeP-FF was obtained after the tube furnace was heated to 300°C (2°C min⁻¹) for 1 h with N₂ gas flowing at 50 sccm.
nodes.source_text: Compared with Ni₂P/FeP-FF, no nickel source was added for the synthetic procedure of FeP-FF.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF shows characteristic peak at 41.2° for (111) plane of Ni₂P; Ni₂P-NF shows peak at 40.7° for (111) Ni₂P; FeP-FF shows no additional peaks except Fe substrate indicating amorphous surface material.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The crystal phases of Ni₂P/FeP-FF, Ni₂P-NF, and FeP-FF were detected through XRD analysis... The remaining peaks at 40.7° of Ni₂P-NF and at 41.2° of Ni₂P/FeP-FF should be indexed to the (111) plane of Ni₂P... no additional peak for FeP-FF except Fe substrate, indicating that the material on FeP-FF surface is amorphous.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF exhibits rambutan-like structure with scattered nanorods; Ni₂P-NF and FeP-FF show spherical particles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM images of Ni₂P-NF, Ni₂P/FeP-FF, and FeP-FF samples were detected... Different from the spherical particles of Ni₂P-NF and FeP-FF catalysts, Ni₂P/FeP-FF catalysts exhibit rambutan-like structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF shows rambutan-like structure confirmed by TEM.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The rambutan-like structure of Ni₂P/FeP-FF electrocatalyst was also confirmed by the TEM image in Figure 1e.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF consists of nanograins ≈15 nm and amorphous materials forming heterogeneous structure; lattice fringe of 0.25 nm belongs to (200) plane of Ni₂P.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the high-resolution TEM (HR-TEM) image... Ni₂P/FeP-FF consists of nanograins (≈15 nm) and amorphous materials... The lattice fringe of 0.25 nm in the nanograin could belong to the (200) plane of Ni₂P.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF surface shows atomic ratio Ni:Fe:P = 3:16:17.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the atomic ratio of Ni:Fe:P on Ni₂P/FeP-FF surface (Table S1, Supporting Information) is 3:16:17 which was obtained from energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS)

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF shows Fe-O peak at 711.5 eV (positive shift 0.3 eV vs FeP-FF), Ni-O peak intensity increased vs Ni₂P-NF, Fe-P at 707.0 eV (negative shift), Ni-P at 853.4 eV (positive shift), P-O at 133.7 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to Fe 2p in Figure 2a, the Fe-O peak of Ni₂P/FeP-FF at 711.5 eV appears a positive shift of 0.3 eV with respect to FeP-FF... According to Ni 2p in Figure 2b, the Ni-O peak intensity increases significantly... Fe-P peak of Ni₂P/FeP-FF at 707.0 eV appears a negative shift relative to FeP-FF and Ni-P peak of Ni₂P/FeP-FF at 853.4 eV presents a positive shift relative to Ni₂P-NF... the position of P-O peak of Ni₂P/FeP-FF at 133.7 eV is right located at between that of Ni₂P-NF and FeP-FF.

nodes.characterization_summary: Time-dependent in situ Raman in 1.0 M KOH: Ni₂P/FeP-FF shows Fe-O signals at 680 and 537 cm⁻¹ (positive shift vs FeP-FF at 664 and 534 cm⁻¹); Ni₂P-NF shows Ni-O at 476 cm⁻¹ and phosphate at 1063 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the evolution process of prepared samples in 1.0 M KOH with immersion time were detected by in situ Raman spectroscopy... From Figure 2e,f, the Fe-O signals of Ni₂P/FeP-FF at 680 and 537 cm⁻¹ corresponding to the FeOOH phase appeared a positive shift compared to the signals of FeP-FF at 664 and 534 cm⁻¹ corresponding to the ferro-ferric oxides.

nodes.characterization_summary: Cdl of Ni₂P/FeP-FF calculated as 14.5 mF cm⁻¹, superior to Ni₂P-NF (4.3 mF cm⁻¹) and FeP-FF (8.5 mF cm⁻¹).
nodes.evidence_snippet: the Cdl value of Ni₂P/FeP-FF is calculated as 14.5 mF cm⁻¹, >4.3 mF cm⁻¹ of Ni₂P-NF and 8.5 mF cm⁻¹ of FeP-FF

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF shows Rct = 0.15 Ω, lower than Ni₂P-NF (0.56 Ω), FeP-FF (1.55 Ω), RuO₂ (1.87 Ω).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni₂P/FeP-FF (0.15 Ω) exhibits lower charge transfer resistance (Rct) than Ni₂P-NF (0.56 Ω), FeP-FF (1.55 Ω), and commercial RuO₂ (1.87 Ω).

nodes.characterization_summary: Potential-dependent in situ Raman: Ni₂P/FeP-FF shows Ni-O at 470 cm⁻¹ and Fe-O at 680 cm⁻¹ corresponding to NiOOH and FeOOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From Figure 4c, both Ni-O features at 470 cm⁻¹ and Fe-O features at 680 cm⁻¹ of Ni₂P/FeP-FF violently appeared.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF after OER shows characteristic Ni₂P peak at 40.7° still visible.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the XRD pattern in Figure 4d, the characteristic peak at 40.7° corresponding to Ni₂P phase was still clearly visible for Ni₂P/FeP-FF after OER.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF after OER: Fe-O peak position unchanged; Ni-P and Fe-P peaks disappeared; P 2p signal weakened; O 1s at 531.5 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For Fe 2p in Figure 4e, the characteristic peak of Fe-O did not change position before and after OER... peaks of Ni-P and Fe-P almost thoroughly disappeared... P 2p signal greatly weakened after OER, and the characteristic peak of O 1s violently appeared at 531.5 cm⁻¹.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF after OER shows characteristic peaks of NiOOH and FeOOH phases.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the Raman spectra of Ni₂P/FeP-FF after OER in Figure 4f, characteristic peaks of NiOOH and FeOOH phases could be easily observed.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF after OER shows 200 nm NiFe oxyhydroxides nanoparticles; lattice fringes 0.25 nm (101) FeOOH and 0.21 nm (111) NiOOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From TEM images of Ni₂P/FeP-FF after OER... 200 nm of NiFe oxyhydroxides nanoparticles could be clearly observed. HR-TEM images show... interlayer distances are measured to be 0.25 and 0.21 nm which are well indexed to the (101) crystal plane of FeOOH and (111) crystal plane of NiOOH.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF after HER shows Ni₂P phase still exists.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the XRD pattern in Figure 5a, the Ni₂P phase still existed in Ni₂P/FeP-FF after HER.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF after HER: Ni-O peak shows negative shift vs pristine.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the Ni 2p in Figure 5b, the Ni-O peak of Ni₂P/FeP-FF after HER occurred a negative shift with respect to that of Ni₂P/FeP-FF.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF after HER shows peaks at 459 and 530 cm⁻¹ for Ni(OH)₂ (stronger than FeOOH).
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the Raman spectra of Ni₂P/FeP-FF after HER... peaks at 459 and 530 cm⁻¹ indexed to Ni(OH)₂ were also observed, and the signal intensity of Ni(OH)₂ is obviously higher than FeOOH.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P/FeP-FF after HER shows ≈10 nm particles; lattice fringes 0.25 nm (101) FeOOH or (200) Ni₂P, 0.46 nm (001) Ni(OH)₂, 0.29 nm (110) Ni₂P; Ni₂P/Ni(OH)₂ heterojunction observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the SEM and TEM images... particles of Ni₂P/FeP-FF after HER are ≈10 nm... the lattice fringes with interlayer distances of 0.25, 0.46, and 0.29 nm... In Figure 5g, the crystal stripe of Ni₂P/Ni(OH)₂ heterojunction was marked by an orange oval.
